name: agree by collecting majority promises, then majority accepts
mechanism: a proposer picks a round number higher than any it has used, collects promises from a majority not to accept lower rounds (learning any value they already accepted), then asks the majority to accept the highest such value or its own; a value accepted by a majority is chosen and can never be changed

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Paxos algorithm' in section Distributed systems algorithms:
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Chandra–Toueg consensus algorithm':

requires: a majority of non-faulty nodes that respond
fails_when: duelling proposers may never terminate (liveness needs a leader or randomness)
